name: claude-code-ui-patch
description: Patch Claude Code with finegrained UI settings for font sizes, code blocks, diff cards, and more.

commands.title: Claude Code UI Patch: Open Panel

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatHistoryFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat font size in px, private to Claude Code so other chat panels are unaffected. `0` follows `#chat.fontSize#`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatHistoryFontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for the chat history only; the interface and input box stay native. Empty = native.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatInputHistoryFontSi.markdownDescription: Text size in px for your sent messages in the chat history only (the user-input text); attachment chips, slash-command echoes, the agent transcript, and the input box stay native. `0` follows `#chat.fontSize#`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatInputHistoryFontFa.markdownDescription: Font family for your sent messages in the chat history only (the user-input text); attachment chips, slash-command echoes, the agent transcript, and the input box stay native. Empty = native.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatCodeBlockFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat fenced code block size in px.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatCodeInlineFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat inline code size in px. `0` follows `#claudeCodeUiPatch.chatCodeBlockFontSize#`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.codeFontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for code **only**, applied to every code surface at once: fenced blocks and inline code in the chat panel and in the Plan Mode preview, plus the permission command block. Prose text, interface chrome, and diff cards stay native. Empty = native monospace. Quote a family with spaces and add a fallback, e.g. `"Fira Code, JetBrains Mono"`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatInputMaxLines.markdownDescription: Chat input box growth cap, in lines: the box grows to this many lines before it scrolls (clamped to 70% of the window height), and typing at the end always keeps the box's bottom padding in view, so the last line never sits flush on the edge. `0` = native: a fixed 200px cap, whose line count depends on `#chat.fontSize#`, and the bottom padding can scroll out of view.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardFontSize.markdownDescription: Diff card code size in px (Edit/MultiEdit cards and the expand modal).

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardLineNumber.markdownDescription: Show line numbers in the diff card, with real `+`/`-` gutter signs. Lines are numbered by their true position in the edited file when the edit's location is known (live edits); cards replayed from history, failed edits, and `replace_all` edits number from 1. The gutter is as narrow as the shown digits require.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatDiffCardThemeSync.markdownDescription: Sync the diff card theme to the VS Code light/dark theme instead of forcing dark.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatMathRendering.markdownDescription: Render TeX math in agent chat messages with a bundled KaTeX (`$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)`, `\[...\]`). Math is detected in the raw markdown before the parser runs, so underscores and asterisks inside math never turn into emphasis, and math inside code blocks or inline code is left alone. `$$...$$` renders as display math when it sits alone on its line(s), inline otherwise; a `$...$` opener followed by whitespace or a closer next to whitespace/digits stays literal, so `$5 and $10` is untouched. Off = native (raw TeX source shown).

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatMathFontSizeEm.markdownDescription: Math size in `em`, relative to the surrounding chat text (applies while `#claudeCodeUiPatch.chatMathRendering#` is on). KaTeX's own default is `1.21`, sized for documents; `1.0` matches the surrounding text.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatPermissionCodeMatc.markdownDescription: Size the permission command block to match the tool input block (`0.85em` instead of `0.9em`).

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatPermissionCodeNoWr.markdownDescription: Stop the permission command block from wrapping: switch it to `white-space: pre` with horizontal scroll, so each visual row is exactly one logical line. A long command then scrolls sideways instead of wrapping ambiguously onto the next row. (Line numbers / syntax highlighting aren't available here: the command is a single editable text node with no per-line structure.)

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatScrollToBottomDot.markdownDescription: Show a small always-visible button just above the chat input box's top-right corner (outside its contour); clicking scrolls back to the latest message, and it dims when the view is already at the bottom. The button mirrors the send button's rounded-square shape with a downward arrow, in the input's own neutral surface and text color. With `#claudeCodeUiPatch.chatJumpToMessageButtons#` also on, the jump buttons line up on its left.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatJumpToMessageButto.markdownDescription: Show two always-visible buttons above the chat input box's top-right corner (a chevron-up "previous" and a chevron-down "next"). Each user message pins to the top as a sticky header while its responses scroll under it; **previous** jumps up so the turn's header sits exactly where pinning holds it (from the bottom, that is the newest user message), and **next** jumps down to the following turn, with the same 100ms glide as the scroll-to-bottom button (instant under reduced motion). A direction with nowhere to go dims. Same rounded-square shape and hover as the scroll-to-bottom button; with `#claudeCodeUiPatch.chatScrollToBottomDot#` also on, the pair lines up on its left, and otherwise slides into its slot.

claudeCodeUiPatch.chatShowMoreAndLessAli.markdownDescription: Pin the chat message "Show more" and "Show less" buttons to a side. Empty = native (drifting) position; `left` or `right` places them deterministically.

claudeCodeUiPatch.effortSyncFix.markdownDescription: On window reload, push the persisted effort level to the CLI so it does not silently run at the default.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewFontSize.markdownDescription: Plan preview text size in px (headings scale with it).

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewFontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for the Plan Mode preview panel. Empty = native.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCodeBlockFo.markdownDescription: Plan preview fenced code block size in px.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCodeInlineF.markdownDescription: Plan preview inline code size in px. `0` follows `#claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCodeBlockFontSize#`.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentInpu.markdownDescription: Plan preview comment box text size in px.
Plan preview comment box height in rows. `0` = native (about 3).
In the plan preview comment box, send on `Cmd`/`Ctrl`+`Enter` and let plain `Enter` insert a newline. Off = native (`Enter` sends, `Shift`+`Enter` newlines).

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentQuot.markdownDescription: Plan preview selected-quote size in px.

claudeCodeUiPatch.planPreviewCommentBadg.markdownDescription: Plan preview comment badge size in px (14px circle, keep <= 12).
